```python
def test_imp_table_exposes_the_verdict_fields(tmp_path):
    """IMP-20260805-355016: verdict/verified_at/cost/fix_site must be readable
    in the table itself, not only through `show` and `--json`."""
    store = tmp_path / "backlog"
    BACKLOG.import_legacy(
        _table(
            "| IMP-0001 | 2026-06-13 | review gate | tool | low | open | fields invisible | "
            "—(2026-08-05 驗證 CONFIRMED-OPEN;落點 `ops/backlog.py:10`,成本 M) |"
        ),
        store,
    )

    rendered = BACKLOG.render_view(store, verified_against="deadbeef")
    header = next(l for l in rendered.splitlines() if l.startswith("| id |"))
    assert tuple(c.strip() for c in header.strip().strip("|").split("|")) == BACKLOG.IMP_COLUMNS

    row = next(l for l in rendered.splitlines() if l.startswith("| IMP-0001 |"))
    cells = dict(zip(BACKLOG.IMP_COLUMNS, [c.strip() for c in row.strip().strip("|").split("|")]))
    assert cells["verdict"] == "CONFIRMED-OPEN"
    assert cells["verified_at"] == "2026-08-05"
    assert cells["cost"] == "M"
    assert cells["fix_site"] == "ops/backlog.py:10"


@pytest.mark.skipif(not LEGACY_DOC.exists(), reason="ledger not present")
def test_shipped_view_header_matches_the_wide_imp_table():
    """The SHIPPED file must actually carry the wide table.

    Widening the renderer and forgetting to re-run `render --commit` would
    leave every other test green while the file people actually read is still
    the narrow one — which is exactly the complaint IMP-20260805-355016 filed.
    This is the only automatic link left between the store and the shipped

```
